description.value: The Ground is a cafe and coffee house in British Columbia's North Coast and Haida Gwaii region, a remote and strikingly scenic destination for touring cyclists. Its Facebook presence suggests it doubles as a gallery space, making it a cultural as well as culinary stop. Cyclists passing through this area will find few services, making this kind of community-oriented cafe a notable waypoint.
